setup.clone: git clone --filter=blob:none https://github.com/hynek/structlog /tmp/rio-acceptance-structlog; git fetch --refetch --no-filter origin
setup.environment: python3 -m venv .venv; .venv/bin/pip install -e . pytest pytest-asyncio pytest-randomly simplejson time-machine mypy ruff coverage rich twisted
setup.trusted_profile:
version: 1
name: acceptance-structlog-trusted
extends: rio/base
budget:
  fast: {wall_time: 90s}
steps:
  - id: prepare
    uses: rio/prepare
  - id: checks
    uses: rio/checks
    needs: [prepare]
    with:
      trust_installed_dependencies: true
  - id: graph
    uses: rio/graph
    needs: [prepare]
  - id: report
    uses: rio/report
    needs: [checks, graph]

misses.description: Replacing the dict of file locks with WeakKeyDictionary rejects existing hashable file-like writers that cannot be weakly referenced. WriteLogger raises TypeError before writing.

evidence.message: cannot create weak reference to 'SlotWriter' object

misses.scope_note: A duck-typed writer has the write/flush API already consumed by WriteLogger; this compatibility edge case is absent from the upstream GC lifecycle test. The miss is within semantic review scope; Rio deferred semantic agents because no model endpoint was configured.
